strengths: Tight IDE integration — sees your open file and project context automatically
Strong for in-line code completion and quick fixes
weaknesses: Context window varies by model selection; less control than direct API
Behaviour shifts when GitHub updates the underlying model
prompting_quirks: Use #file, #selection, and other Copilot context references explicitly
Switching the underlying model (Claude / GPT options) materially changes behavior
Workspace indexing improves answers — invest in it for larger repos
best_for: Quick questions about the file in front of you
avoid_for: Long-horizon planning or multi-file architecture changes (use Claude Code or Codex CLI)
Anything where you need a stable, named model version
notes: Copilot routes to different underlying models. Check which model is configured — your scorecard will reflect the model in use, not an abstract 'Copilot' baseline.
pricing_notes: Subscription-based, not per-token. Plans (Free/Pro/Pro+/Business/Enterprise) vary by monthly request quota; cost per prompt depends on plan and underlying model. Use vendor pricing page for current rates.
